title: Carrier Delivery Confirmation on Pocketwire Business Profile Sales
content:
On a Pocketwire Business Profile, delivery is confirmed only by the carrier, through the tracking the seller added to the sale. A delivery date stated by the seller or by the buyer is never recorded as a confirmation.

One confirmation is recorded per sale, carrying the delivery date the carrier reported and the carrier tracking number. That carrier delivery confirmation is the evidence both for the early release of a new-seller hold or a high-risk hold on the sale and for seller protection on item-not-received and unauthorized-buyer claims.

**Questions the rule answers**

- *The seller says the parcel arrived yesterday, but the carrier has not confirmed it.* No confirmation is recorded; the seller's statement is not a confirmation.
- *Can a sale carry two delivery confirmations?* No; one confirmation is recorded per sale.
